9.description: uses a wide range of vocabulary with very natural and sophisticated control of lexical features; rare minor errors occur only as 'slips'

2.description: uses an extremely limited range of vocabulary; essentially no control of word formation and/or spelling

0.description: does not attend; does not attempt the task in any way
